## Project knowledge (generated by Pixl)

The project knowledge is kept as markdown files in `docs/knowledge/`. Read the files you need; you do not have to read them all.
Start with `docs/knowledge/overview.md`. The index is `docs/knowledge/README.md`.

- `docs/knowledge/overview.md`: what the project is for, in short
- `docs/knowledge/modules.md`: the parts of the code and where things live
- `docs/knowledge/features.md`: what was built: every merged story and epic, newest first

Do not edit these files by hand: they are rewritten from the Knowledge tab of the platform.
